name: Predator (Achievement)
body:
You have dedicated your life to hunting and killing your favored enemies.

Prerequisite: Favored enemy class feature. Track and kill 100 creatures of types you’ve selected as your favored enemies.

Benefit: Add your Wisdom bonus (if any) on attack rolls made to confirm a critical hit against creatures of types you’ve selected as your favored enemies.
